title: Pathetic App
text:
Pathetic App. Not suitable for a working professional or international users.  Too much spamming and unprofessional systems. 

- the yoga sessions start late/get canceled. The internet quality of sessions is poor and so is the content - very slow & disorganised 

- you’ll be added to atleast 10 WhatsApp groups: one with dietician, one with yoga instructor, one with health care manager,  one with everyone together, one with all other mums(no privacy) 

You’ll have no idea which group does what. Coaches can message you individually or on group. I have atleast 20+ imum chats on my WhatsApp. 

No way someone can manage all that. Also, most of the content is junk/forwarded messages. 

- the QnA section is good for trivial questions. Any deep or technical question they share generic answers. They have no clue what 
we are talking about. 

Good only if you have almost 0 knowledge of nutrition/exercises and want some guidance in pregnancy. Personally I feel we have access to much better content in today’s era.

title: Show time in the app based on the user’s location
text:
The yoga sessions don’t clarify if they are in India time or the user’s local time incase they are located in a different timezone. It’s very confusing. 

If a 5pm session is happening right now and the user is allowed to join it, why does a 6pm session show a banner that it will happen in 8 hours? Different components are referencing different timezones, one is using user’s location and the other is using hard coded times. Never thought joining a simple class would be this complicated in a time when remote fitness classes are so common.

title: Best App for to be and new mums
text: I have been using iMumz app for a few days now and I am totally hooked on to it. The team makes fantastic efforts to bring out the best content possible. They arrange yoga sessions thrice a week and arrange special knowledge sessions on weekends. In addition to that the team also arranges 'Ask me anything' sessions with doctors. All this interaction with world class professionals makes me feel that my baby and I are in good hands. In addition to all these, the app has great music, bonding exercises and amazing recipes. This app keeps me occupied and constantly gives positive reinforcement to bond with my baby. I gained a lot of knowledge and insights about pregnancy from this app and am happily enjoying this phase, thanks to iMumz. I highly recommend this app to any one who is trying to conceive or currently pregnant or anyone who has recently become a mom. You wouldn't find a better app or support than this.
